meta.name: tin_tundra_camp
meta.prompt: A Bronze Age tin-mining camp on a frozen tundra coast in midwinter: pit heads, smelting fires, hide tents and a beached trading ship.

programs.brief: A Bronze Age sewn-plank wooden trade ship beached at a tilt on the icy shingle shoreline, its hull wedged on frost-locked gravel with cargo bundles, skins, and amphorae scattered on the shore.
A primitive stone-lined charcoal bloomery hearth for smelting cassiterite tin ore, surrounded by black slag scatter, stone anvils, and glowing embers.

tokens.terrain: a barren frozen tundra coast with a rocky shoreline and freezing sea ice
tokens.icons: open pit heads cut into permafrost, charcoal smelting hearths, hide and skin tents, beached Bronze Age trade ship icebound on the shingle, cassiterite ore piles
tokens.infra: cart_track from the tin pits down to the beached ship
